guide_wording: For an ordinary investment-good sale after entry into use, [article 42](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1991-14463#a42) makes one adjustment for the **sale year and all remaining years** of the article 40 period, even if earlier years did not use prorrata. section: The base / 3. Recover eligible input, then allocate
guide_wording: Startup inputs use [arts. 43/43 bis](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1991-14463#a43). Establish business intention by objective evidence and use the proposed provisional percentage, unless ATC fixes another. The first counted year is the habitual-start year only when operations begin **before 1 July**; otherwise it is the following year. A 1 July 2026 start therefore counts **2027–2030**. At the end of the four counted calendar years, compute one definitive art. 37 percentage from **aggregate entitling turnover divided by aggregate included total turnover**, rounded upward, rather than averaging annual percentages.
